answer: A newcomer earns full weight only after a 30-day apprenticeship of useful work. Daily tasks resist bulk scripting, such as logging a smoke plume over a voyage route or mapping karst springs for a ferry crew, reviewed by two rotating mentors staking their standing. Approving a fake costs stake and review rights. One person cannot run ten apprenticeships at once: tasks overlap in real time and need fresh answers, so each fake costs 30 days of labour. Limits: time-poor people are slowed, mentors can collude, and farms can hire labour, so rotation, re-checks and slashing must stay.
